summary: A large team, two central offices and a 4.9 Google rating are strengths, but a wrong phone link, repeated listings and a rating with no reviews shown appear to cost you vendors.

findings.problem: The Central Office number is shown as 0207 052 1075 but its tel link dials 0207 928 6663, the Riverside number.
findings.cost: A client who taps to call reaches the wrong office.
findings.fix: Checked, correct call links for each office.

findings.problem: The Our Team section repeats the same staff cards about three times, and the Latest Properties carousel repeats the same nine listings several times.
findings.cost: Repeated blocks hide what vendors and buyers came to see.
findings.fix: One clean team page and a tidy listings carousel.

findings.problem: Lincoln Square, 18 Portugal Street appears twice with the same title but prices of 1,250,000 and 1,450,000 pounds.
findings.cost: Conflicting prices on a listing damage trust.

findings.problem: The page claims 4.9/5 from 420 Google reviews but shows none, the newsletter has no email box, and the page shows Offers In Excess Of£415,000 and a raw code in image text.
findings.cost: A rating with no visible reviews and small slips weaken your strongest proof.
findings.fix: A live review wall and proofread listings.

redesign: Correct call links and clear office pages.
One clean team page and a tidy listings section.
A live review wall and proofread listings.
